title: Users with 9 notes are told they have none for 760ms
why: A flash of wrong content during the initial sync. Data loads fine, and it's gone before anyone can point at it.
finding: `.notes-list[data-empty="true"]` rendered 'No notes yet' from 54545ms to 55306ms, while the Yjs index snapshot GET had already returned 200.
actual: On opening the workspace the sidebar shows 'No notes yet. Create your first note.' for ~760ms (54545ms → 55306ms), then replaces it with the 9 real notes once the Yjs index document finishes syncing.
expected: While the index document is still syncing the sidebar should show a loading indicator/skeleton (or nothing), and only fall back to the 'No notes yet' empty state after sync completes and confirms the workspace genuinely has zero notes. The user should never be told they have no notes when they do.

chronology.text: 481ms after the click (54545ms) the notes sidebar renders the empty state: '.notes-list' carries data-empty="true" and shows 'No notes yet. Create your first note.' — only 1 interactive element exists in the sidebar (the + add button). The workspace actually has 9 notes, so this empty state is false.

~760ms later (55306ms), once the Yjs index document finishes syncing, the empty state is replaced by the list of 9 real notes (Edge Cases, Poem, New Note, hey, ...) — the sidebar now contains 10 interactive elements. The content the user sees changes from 'no notes' to a full list.

rootCause.text:
In assets/_workspace-Jnfl8jZH.js the notes GridList is rendered with `renderEmptyState: () =>
No notes yet. Create your first note.
` and `children: t.map(...)` where `t` is the notes array. The empty-state branch is gated solely on the notes array being empty — there is no loading/synced flag. During the initial Yjs index-document sync the notes array is empty, so the GridList renders the false 'No notes yet' empty state until the snapshot arrives and populates the array.

rootCauseSteps.text: At Point:19 (54545ms) the '.notes-list' element has attribute data-empty="true" and renders 'No notes yet. Create your first note.', while at Point:20 (55306ms) the same sidebar contains 10 interactive items (the 9 notes plus the add button) — proving the empty state was a transient render, not the real state.

The data load actually succeeds: the Yjs index-document request GET /api/yjs/docs/rooms/ws-apple-index/v3/collaboration?offset=snapshot fires at 54558ms (just after the empty state renders) and the index requests return HTTP 200, after which the notes populate. The empty state was therefore shown during a successful load, not a failed one.
